question:
If '+' means '÷', '-' means '+', '×' means '-' and '÷' means '×', then what will be the value of the following expression?

[{(23 × 15) - (1 ÷ 4)} + (2 - 2)] ÷ 2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3231e6c62dbd267d85e484664b063316c4e298077af22d6fc7b66af36fccb2ed.png] 

Decoding the information,

 
 

 Sign
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Means
 ÷
 +
 -
 ×
 
 

Given: 

[{(23 × 15) - (1 ÷ 4)} + (2 - 2)] ÷ 2

After replacing the signs and using the BODMAS rule:

[{{(23 - 15) + (1 times 4)}} div(2+2)] times 2\ =[{{(8) + (4)}} div(4)] times 2\ =[12÷4]×2\\=3×2\\=6

Hence, the **correct answer is "6".**
